subject: Your first prediction starts here, {first_name}
body_paragraphs: Welcome to Predictify. Quick orientation: every match in the app comes with a calibrated AI confidence score that tells you exactly how reliable the prediction is. Numbers, not vibes.
Try it now: {top_match_line}. Tap the match, see the full breakdown, lock in your call.
Pro tip: pick once a day for 5 days and you build a streak. Streak users are 3x more likely to spot value calls.
